findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jp_diet_bills_list, jp_diet_bill_status, jp_diet_changes · Private data: jp_diet_sessions_list, jp_diet_bill_status · Public sink: jp_diet_group_votes, jp_diet_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jp_diet_bills_list, jp_diet_bill_status, jp_diet_changes · Private data: jp_diet_sessions_list, jp_diet_bill_status · Public sink: jp_diet_group_votes, jp_diet_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
